I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread: the 2026 renewal at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 261 seats.

- **Where it came from:** Ilse posted 261 in #north-team on Oct 14, and nothing in the channel since then changes it.
- **Why it was OK to share:** Dana is a member of #north-team, so she can see that post herself. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure.
- **What I flagged:** I told her the 185 from August 2025 was the Amendment No. 1 count, not the renewal number.

I only read #north-team. I didn't search other channels or check the account files.
